title: neurophyllodes hololeuca
intro: Neurophyllodes hololeuca, commonly known as Brazilian ironwood or ipê-roxo, is a tree species native to Brazil, belonging to the Bignoniaceae family. Neurophyllodes hololeuca is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including its potential to help reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress.
